coverageNotes: Narrows the original component-selection task to the configuration needed for strict per-user spacing. Does not test recognizing or installing the component, auth implementation, or efficiency at scale. Pins source versions Convex 1.41.0 and rate-limiter 0.3.2.

questions.concept: Strict cooldown with the rate-limiter component
questions.question: Which configuration allows the first request immediately, then enforces at least 30 seconds between successful requests, including concurrent requests?

options.rationale: A fixed window refills at its boundary. One success immediately before a boundary and another immediately after it can be less than 30 seconds apart.
A capacity of two allows two accumulated tokens to be consumed in a burst, violating minimum spacing.
Capacity one prevents accumulated bursts, and one token refilled per 30 seconds requires a full 30 seconds between successful one-token requests.
Rate is tokens refilled per period, not a cooldown duration. Thirty tokens per 30 seconds refills one token each second despite capacity one.
